newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police say Briton may have committed suicide.
newsitem.headline: Thai police say Briton may have committed suicide.

text.p: Thai police said on Monday an autopsy was being conducted to determine how a British man whose body was found strapped to a seafront pier had died.
Inspector Phanuwat Kongniwatsiri told Reuters by phone from Sriracha police station: "There were no signs of a struggle...

Police said a man they identified as Geoffrey Chapman, of Scarborough, Yorkshire, England, was found tied to a pole on Sunday at a pier in the small town of Sriracha, 150 km (95 miles) southeast of Bangkok. The body was visible during low tide.
The inspector said Chapman, 54, was apparently weighed down by a heavy rock tied around his legs.
